explanatory_strength.rationale: The company-level capital-cycle chain is stated: FY2025 revenue +83% in an upcycle, FY2025 capex $179.1M exceeded operating cash flow $174.4M, Taiwan lease ROU $72M, and diluted shares rose from ~60M to ~76M after equity offerings. Classification marks cycle up and the deep dive ties margin and FCF distortion to capacity build and customer concentration. The industry supply-response step (competitor capacity additions, utilization, incremental ROIC on new fabs) is not modeled, so the full Marathon mechanism is only half tested.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: Primary filings and valuation_contract proofs reconcile revenue, capex, cash ($439.7M Q1 2026), normalized owner cash $0.74/sh, and the customer_capex_reserve overlap key. valuation_route required_evidence for industry capacity and additions, utilization, and normalized unit margins at the industry level is absent; management_facts_2026-07-17 is empty. Marathon abstention applies until supply lead times and industry capacity can be measured, not just company capex.

downside_control.rationale: Component audit: customer_capex_reserve base −$12/sh and net_financial_claims +$5.34/sh quantify concentration, dilution, and capex-stress reserves with clean overlap keys. Price $99.77 versus additive component base $16.34/sh leaves equity far above filing-normalized midcycle economics; a hyperscaler socket loss or supply-driven margin reset while Taiwan lease and capex obligations persist is not bounded. Dhando is none and equity-funded expansion at cycle-up adds dilution tail risk.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: valuation_contract annualized return at price is −22.77% base and −7.79% high over seven years; Lawrence synthesis is −13.44% base. Both sit well below the ~12% capital-cycle hurdle. Bull scenario growth (20% years 1–5) embeds peak-cycle AI demand without evidenced industry supply discipline. Base economics do not clear the hurdle even before a supply-response haircut.

claims.claim: AAOI is reinvesting heavily at a classified upcycle: FY2025 capex exceeded operating cash flow, Taiwan datacenter capacity build drives a $49M above-maintenance normalized capex assumption, and diluted shares increased ~27% after 2025–2026 equity offerings.

Market price capitalizes peak-cycle growth on thin normalized owner cash: $99.77 per share versus component base $16.34/sh on normalized FCF $0.74/sh implies midcycle returns deeply below the portfolio hurdle (−22.77% annualized at price in the contract base case).

The customer_capex_reserve midcycle_capacity_value component (−$12/sh base) is judgment-only in its calculation proof and does not reconcile industry capacity, utilization, or incremental ROIC; overlap controls are clean but the supply-response audit required by the capital_cycle route cannot be completed from the frozen packet.

strongest_counter_explanation: 800G AI datacenter demand exceeds current optical transceiver supply, AOI's vertically integrated laser fabrication creates a durable cost advantage, and Taiwan capacity—funded while cash was raised at elevated prices—converts to high incremental returns once utilization ramps, making today's margins and growth durable rather than peak-cycle.
most_important_missing_fact: Industry-wide 800G/datacenter optical transceiver capacity additions, fab utilization rates, and announced competitor expansion lead times (including major merchant module vendors) reconciled to demand growth, to test whether current ~30% gross margins survive the supply response.
falsifiers: Announced industry 800G transceiver capacity additions exceed hyperscaler demand growth for two consecutive years while AOI gross margin falls below 25%
Normalized owner cash per share fails to reach $1.00 by FY2027 despite completion of the Taiwan build-out
Combined Digicomm and Microsoft revenue share falls below 60% without replacement volume at comparable margin
specialist_findings: Capital_cycle power zone applies (turnaround, cycle up, midcycle_capacity_value routed). Component audit: datacenter_optics_engine growth rows embed AI ramp already; hyperscaler_share_runway (+$8/sh base) risks double-counting share gains above normalized FCF0; customer_capex_reserve uses midcycle_capacity_value label but proof traces are single judgment nodes, not capacity×utilization×margin math. net_financial_claims overlap key is distinct. Reported FY2025 FCF was negative; normalized capex is an explicit [Assumption]—peak margins may be capitalized if normalization is too generous. Q1 run-rate FCF (~$1.43/sh annualized) is correctly excluded from FCF0 but highlights how sensitive cycle timing is. Defer until industry supply-response evidence resolves; on available filing economics, returns fail the hurdle and entry at cycle-up is contraindicated.
